explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/611: estimate the minimal k_c(n) such that every G whose maximal cliques all have ≥ k_c(n) vertices has τ(G) < (1−c)n. cliqueThreshold c n is that sInf. The statement asks for a Θ-equivalent answer function of (c, n) for 0 < c < 1. c ≥ 1 is excluded because the condition τ < (1−c)n ≤ 0 is then impossible, which the docstring explains. Θ is a reasonable reading of 'estimate'. Faithful.
